messages:
alinag: Hey team — Cumulus wants a regional failover set up for EU (Frankfurt) + an IP allowlist for their edge peering for the pilot. They also asked for a temporary RL bump during onboarding (x10 for 72h). Can we confirm feasibility and lead time?

csm_emma: Thanks for the heads up. renewal flag: low risk right now but onboarding velocity matters. If we can greenlight the bump + failover quickly, it improves their confidence.

samir: I can do the config changes but need the customer subnet CIDRs and which model route to failover to (prod vs lower-cost fallback). Also confirm whether they need dedicated capacity or just routing priority.

alinag: They provided subnets: `10.32.8.0/24`, `10.32.9.0/24`. Prefer failover to `gptx-v2-medium` (same latency profile) and temporary rate increase for API key `cumulus-prod-key-01`. Dedicated capacity not required for pilot.

nate_support: @samir I filed a ticket with infra: INC-2026-911. Deploy-bot created a provisioning request: `provision_request_id=pr-88321`. ETA for rule propagation usually ~15-30m after apply, but cross-region routing + DNS failover may take longer.

deploy-bot: [system] Provision request pr-88321 submitted to eng-infra; status=queued.

samir: Copy. I'll schedule the allowlist + rate window. Proposed plan: 1) add allowlist entries to edge ACL, 2) add route with higher priority to frankfurt pool for key, 3) create RL policy: factor=10, window=72h. Applying at 10:30 UTC unless objections.

csm_emma: Works for me. Can we add a canary rule so only 5% traffic uses failover first hour? Customer wants confidence checks.

samir: Good call. I'll implement weighted routing: canary=5% -> frankfurt, 95% -> primary. After 1h we ramp to 100% frankfurt if no errors.

alinag: Customer will run smoke tests and send results in this thread. Also asked for an audit log export for the window — please attach to the ticket.

nate_support: Noted. ATTACH: `INC-2026-911/log-export-request` assigned to ops oncall.

samir: Applied initial canary at 10:31 UTC. ACL entries added for `10.32.8.0/24` and `10.32.9.0/24`. RL policy deployed (see snippet):
```
route: cumulus-prod-key-01
priority: frankfurt_pool:+20
weighted_routing: { frankfurt: 5, primary: 95 }
rate_limit: factor:10, duration_hours:72
```

deploy-bot: [system] Rule apply complete for pr-88321; status=success at 1708123610.

alinag: Customer reports successful smoke tests (latency within SLA, no auth errors). Emma — please capture feedback for renewal playbook.

csm_emma: Will add to Cumulus onboarding notes: positive experience, highlight fast failover setup and temporary RL flexibility. Also schedule a 1:1 review in 2 weeks.

samir: I'll monitor metrics for 24h and post anomalies. If all good, I'll ramp to 100% at 11:31 UTC.

alinag: Thanks all :tada:
